Maxine Cain punches the air as she shouts “no justice, no peace” while marching at a rally at the state Capitol building, demanding justice in the police shooting that killed the Congolese immigrant Patrick Lyoya, in Lansing, Michigan #BlackLivesMatter 
Credit: AP Photo/Jake May https://t.co/HTP1exb9KB

President Joe Biden and first lady Jill Biden visit the scene of a shooting at a supermarket to pay respects and speak to families of the victims of Saturday's shooting in Buffalo, New York State #BlackLivesMatter 
Credit: AP Photo/Andrew Harnik https://t.co/vkVWSzZgEE

Mourners light candles at a makeshift memorial outside Tops market in Buffalo, New York state. A gunman killed 10 people and wounded another three on Monday. The attack was believed to be racially motivated #BlackLivesMatter 
Credit: Scott Olson/Getty Images https://t.co/iGl5r4ehr9

A young girl looks at a memorial in the wake of a weekend shooting at a Tops supermarket in Buffalo, New York state #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: REUTERS/Brendan McDermid https://t.co/vyM4GlGYwX

A person visits a makeshift memorial near the scene of the shooting at a supermarket, in Buffalo, New York State #BlackLivesMatter 
Credit: AP Photo/Matt Rourke https://t.co/dXK6fqIdBn
